systems.owner: Direction des Finances Locales, Direction Generale du Tresor et de la Comptabilite Publique
systems.tiers: urban and rural communes; generalised by joint circular 005-2022 MIDEC/MF

note: SIGeL is described as covering the budget, commitment and payment chain and producing accounts (accounts class); it is not described as recording payers or bills. The note says part of communal revenue (urban and interurban patente, contribution fonciere, flat fines, landed-tonnage tax) is collected by the State for communes and passed on by the Treasury (central, not a system). Communal revenue figures are accounting data, not a record of payers.
